title: Add JSON Schema Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a zero‑dependency middleware that validates request bodies against user‑provided JSON schemas. This prevents malformed data from reaching route handlers, reduces boilerplate validation code, and improves API reliability.
testCases: Valid request body passes validation and reaches the handler
Invalid request body returns 400 with detailed error messages
Missing schema defaults to a no‑op (passes all requests)
Schema with required fields and type constraints correctly identifies missing or wrong‑typed fields
acceptance: When the middleware is registered with a schema, any request that does not conform returns a 400 response containing a JSON error object; conforming requests proceed unchanged. The middleware must not affect performance noticeably and must log validation failures at debug level.
reason: Current yantraverse apps rely on manual checks in each route, leading to duplicated code and inconsistent error handling. A central validation layer raises overall code quality, speeds up development, and aligns with the framework's goal of being a production‑ready, zero‑dependency solution.
